g.title: Enif
g.desc: Happy birthday Trap. Wherever you go, you always bring so much warmth and care to everyone around you, and your energy is just amazing. I hope this year brings you so much happiness, good health, and great things in your career and love life.

g.title: Insomniac11
g.desc: Happy Birthdayyy! 🥂🎂 Even though we haven't really crossed paths, a birthday is always a good excuse to send some good wishes your way. Hope this new chapter brings you endless happiness, beautiful surprises, genuine people and countless reasons to smile. May you have the loveliest day and an even lovelier year ahead. Stay blessed! ♡
